item.title: OllaLink: A Simpler Approach to Remote Access
item.summary: Remote infrastructure can become difficult to manage as teams and devices grow. [OllaLink](https://ollalink.com/)takes a browser-based approach to remote access, aiming to make connecting to and managing remote systems more straightforward from a familiar interface.
